description.value: Kim's Family Korean Restaurant is a Korean eatery on Lonsdale Avenue in North Vancouver. The Korean-script name (김 고 집 순대국밥) suggests a focus on sundae gukbap, a hearty traditional Korean soup with blood sausage and offal — a warming, filling meal well-suited to cyclists riding the North Shore. The restaurant sits on a busy corridor close to the Lonsdale Quay transit hub.
